summary:
• Meta’s Muse Gadgets — an open‑source kit that lets developers attach hardware to Meta’s personal AI agent, enabling tangible actions such as scheduling meetings or controlling lights.
• Gemini 4 Argon — Google DeepMind’s frontier model with million‑token context, allowing extremely long, multi‑step reasoning for tasks like code reviews or legal research.
• GPT‑6 model guide — a concise playbook that helps startups select the appropriate GPT‑6 variant, tune reasoning depth, and integrate tools into production pipelines.
• Claude Code — an update that adds a fullscreen text‑selection helper, built‑in GitHub API, and prompt recovery shortcut, reducing friction for developers using Claude for coding assistance.
• AI System Design — an open‑source collection of lessons and runnable code that guides building LLM‑powered retrieval, generation, and autonomous‑agent pipelines, accelerating prototype to production.
• Strands Decider — a system‑one decision model from Strands that replaces the language head with fast option scoring, delivering sub‑second choices for agentic workflows.
